name: Vendetta
source:
The Magician of February / The Corruption Magician

[spoiler]The other February Magician originally named Februum who can communicate and quell corrupted spirits simply by conversing and sympathizing with them. Misunderstood by humans hundreds of years ago to be an ally of the dangerous corrupted spirits, he was repeatedly tortured and killed. Eventually losing his mind from this, he was determined to have his revenge on those who wronged him until Airy stopped him.

After the battle, Februum lost most of his memories and woke up as Vendetta, a soul without a body. Years later, he found and saved Rieffe from the brink of death by merging with him.[/spoiler]

Vendetta is a do-unto-others type of person who simply wants to live alone and in peace. He has an overly straightforward personality and way of thinking, which gets him misunderstood and disliked by many. As cold as he may or may not be, he's developed a soft spot after being influenced by Rieffe's soul and memories.

[From [url=https://toyhou.se/12680449.vendetta]official bio[/url]]
